Let

\[
S=\sum_{n=1}^{32}(-1)^n\left\lfloor\frac{32}{n}\right\rfloor\varphi(n).
\]

The floor function counts multiples:

\[
\left\lfloor\frac{32}{n}\right\rfloor=\#\{k\ge1:nk\le 32\}.
\]

Thus

\[
S=\sum_{n=1}^{32}(-1)^n\varphi(n)\sum_{k=1}^{\lfloor 32/n\rfloor}1
=\sum_{m=1}^{32}\sum_{d\mid m}(-1)^d\varphi(d).
\]

Define

\[
T(m)=\sum_{d\mid m}(-1)^d\varphi(d).
\]

We evaluate \(T(m)\).

### 1. \(m\) odd

Every divisor \(d\mid m\) is odd, so \((-1)^d=-1\). Hence

\[
T(m)=-\sum_{d\mid m}\varphi(d)=-m.
\]

### 2. \(m\) even

Write \(m=2^a q\) with \(a\ge1\) and \(q\) odd. Divisors have the form \(d=2^b e\), where \(0\le b\le a\) and \(e\mid q\).

For fixed \(e\mid q\),

\[
\sum_{b=0}^a (-1)^{2^b e}\varphi(2^b e)
=
-\varphi(e)+\sum_{b=1}^a \varphi(2^b e).
\]

Since \(e\) is odd and \(b\ge1\),

\[
\varphi(2^b e)=2^{b-1}\varphi(e).
\]

Therefore

\[
-\varphi(e)+\varphi(e)\sum_{b=1}^a 2^{b-1}
=
-\varphi(e)+\varphi(e)(2^a-1)
=
(2^a-2)\varphi(e).
\]

Summing over \(e\mid q\),

\[
T(m)=(2^a-2)\sum_{e\mid q}\varphi(e)=(2^a-2)q.
\]

Now sum \(T(m)\) for \(1\le m\le 32\).

### Odd \(m\)

\[
\sum_{\substack{1\le m\le32\\ m\text{ odd}}}T(m)
=
-(1+3+\cdots+31)
=
-16^2
=
-256.
\]

### Even \(m\)

Group by \(a=v_2(m)\):

\[
\begin{array}{c|c|c|c}
a & q \text{ allowed} & T(2^a q) & \text{contribution} \\
\hline
1 & 1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15 & 0 & 0 \\
2 & 1,3,5,7 & 2q & 2(1+3+5+7)=32 \\
3 & 1,3 & 6q & 6(1+3)=24 \\
4 & 1 & 14 & 14 \\
5 & 1 & 30 & 30
\end{array}
\]

So the even contribution is

\[
0+32+24+14+30=100.
\]

Therefore

\[
S=-256+100=-156.
\]

\[
\boxed{-156}
\]
